stories.title: Forecast: Warming up through the rest of this week; another cool down next week
stories.summary: Here are the latest updates from the KVUE Weather Impact Team.

stories.title: Community pushback prompts renewed discussion over Williamson County justice complex
stories.summary: The proposed site in southeast Georgetown has drawn concerns from residents about traffic, safety and the potential impact on nearby schools and families.

stories.title: Uber launches 'Uber Kids' in select cities, including Austin, for a limited time
stories.summary: According to the company, Uber Kids is designed to keep the guardian in control for kids 10-12.

stories.title: Residents demand water quality protections for Canyon Lake
stories.summary: Petitioners told the TCEQ they want protections similar to those in place for the Highland Lakes.

stories.title: A suspect stole an ATM from a bank in Dallas overnight using a forklift as a getaway vehicle
stories.summary: Dallas police say the burglary occurred around 3:30 a.m. and the investigation is ongoing.

stories.title: San Antonio man accused of faking veteran status to win $1.6M in federal contracts
stories.summary: Prosecutors say the man posed as a member of 7 federal entities, including 4 military branches and tried to sell the U.S. counterfeit weapon lights made in China.

stories.title: Akins High School student detained after altercation on campus
stories.summary: Austin ISD officials said a student suffered a non-life-threatening puncture wound from scissors during the incident on Wednesday.

stories.title: Texas comptroller proposes ending sales tax on Netflix, Hulu and other streaming services
stories.summary: Don Huffines announced Tuesday that his office has proposed rule changes to end the tax on streaming subscriptions, which the agency has taxed since 2014.

stories.title: Austin secures $500K in matching funds for former foster youth housing assistance
stories.summary: The matching funds bring the total to $1 million to help former foster youth transition to independence.

stories.title: What sparked the Clean Harbors explosion? Investigators say key questions remain
stories.summary: Investigators say hydrocarbon vapors caused the Clean Harbors explosion, but the ignition source remains unknown. Two earlier fires are also under scrutiny.

stories.title: Houston shrimp investigation finds nearly half of sampled restaurants misrepresented imported seafood
stories.summary: An investigation found that 10 of 22 Houston restaurants tested served imported shrimp while misrepresenting it as local, American wild-caught or Gulf shrimp.

stories.title: Williamson County receives more than $17.5M from federal grant to enhance safety at dozens of street crossings
stories.summary: The grant will fund 80% of the total cost of at least $21.9 million.
